example.title: Yacht club clubhouse on the harbour (Bahia Corinthian Yacht Club)
example.place: Corona del Mar, Newport Beach, Orange County, CA

brief: A c. 1980 yacht clubhouse on the water: a long low building with a broad grey hipped roof, white walls and a continuous glazed ground floor opening onto a terrace of white umbrellas, the club name in raised letters on the fascia, a flagpole with signal yard, and a basin of sailing yachts on floating docks in front. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
